positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed NoSQL Firebase facilitating personalized test feedback to 1500 + high school and middle school students
Programming and testing application’s client-side and server-side using Nodejs giving students an interactive environment

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Built Java Data Extraction tool to mine and extract information from thousands of SEC company filings

Created Chrome Extension to display financial and company acronyms for new hires and veteran employees

Produced autonomous script mapping Bloomberg tickers to BlackRock’s internal company issuer ids

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: The project I am working on involves extending the life of low-fuel satellites in orbit via attachment and propulsion of the MEV (Mission Extension Vehicle).  My role in this project is adding to and debugging the test suite for the simulation in STOL (Satellite Test and Operations Language) and participating in code reviews (C++).

positions.title: Winter Intern
positions.description: Led a small group help non-profit organization World Education transition their Adult Literacy and Education blog to a new website (from weebly to wordpress), and developed a web tool to facilitate accessing web tools used in blogs.

positions.title: Front Desk Worker
positions.description:
• Execute Customer Service via phone calls and walk-ins
• Approve On-Campus events through the EMS Software

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Designed training programs for Freshmen in workshop machines including but not limited to 3D printers, laser cutters, bandsaws and drill presses
• Collaborated with mentors and trained Freshmen how to use workshop machines/tools
• Designed safety videos for trainings (https://youtu.be/duG07rJ69Bs)
